items.title: NWS daily climate report: settlement-version check
items.description: Reports which issuance of the NWS CLI product (preliminary, final, correction) carries the official max temperature for a station and date, with issuance times, and quotes the exchange rule that names the version. Used for NYC Central Park (CLINYC), Chicago-Midway (CLIMDW), Atlanta (CLIATL), and Boston (CLIBOS).

items.title: Chicago Midway station pack (title vs settlement)
items.description: Confirms the contract settles on Chicago-Midway (not O'Hare), returns the Midway NWS CLI issuance used for the date, and quotes the title-vs-rule mismatch. Demo SKU for the Midway edge story.

items.title: Sports settlement-version pack
items.description: Quotes which StatsScore / Sportradar / league official-result feed version (including corrections) Gemini uses to settle a sports contract, with the rule language that names it.

items.title: Commodity index settlement-version pack
items.description: Reports which Kaiko (or named) index print and correction policy settles a commodity contract, with issuance timing and the exchange rule that picks the version.

items.title: Crypto reference-rate settlement-version pack
items.description: Reports which Lukka (or named) reference-rate print and correction policy settles a crypto contract, with issuance timing and the exchange rule that picks the version.

items.title: NWS daily climate report: settlement-version check (Circle Gateway nanopayment)
items.description: Same document as cat-nws-cli-settlement-version-v1, sold for 0.001 USDC over Circle Gateway nanopayments on Arc Testnet.

items.title: Point temperature forecast
items.description: Model forecast of the daily max. Changes the event probability, not the settlement risk.

items.title: LM Arena leaderboard snapshot (style control off)
items.description: Timestamped capture of the leaderboard view a contract settles on.
